metadata.title: मणिपुर इंटरनेट बैन से किसका फ़ायदा हुआ? | What purpose internet ban served in Manipur?
metadata.description: The state government banned internet in the first week of May after the violence started on 3 May. After two months a video went viral showing two Kuki women paraded naked by a mob in Imphal. This video brought out the severity of the violence happening in Manipur. The questions are also asked is internet ban was to keep whole country in dark about Manipur violence?
